notes: At verse 4 the ASV writes the same compound name in two words (*Romamti ezer*) and each token takes the element written for it; here it writes one word, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the two tokens share a unit, headed on the governing first token (rule 23).
The waw stands between the same two numerals the English *and* joins (rule 42); the supplied *the* stands before the first numeral's own word and joins its unit (rules 15 and 31).
